SELECT PTL.FINPROD_ID finProdId, PTL.ACCT_NO acctNo, PTL.CCY ccy, PTL.ACCT_TYPE acctType, STL.ACCT_NAME acctName, STL.BANK_DEP bankDep, STL.LARGE_PAYNO largePayNo, STL.IN_OUT_BANK inOutBank, STL.CORR_NO corrNo, STL.LARGE_PAYNO largePayno, STL.SWIFT_CODE swiftCode, STL.BLN_AREA blnArea, STL.IS_OVERDRAW isOverdraw, PTL.REMARK remark, case when fin_product.PROFIT_TYPE= #{PROFIT_TYPE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.DEAL_MODE = #{DISPOSE_PATTERN_11,jdbcType=VARCHAR} then (select CASH_ID from STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT ,fin_product where STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT.FINPROD_ID = fin_product.finprod_id and fin_product.p_finprod_id = PTL.FINPROD_ID and STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT.ACCT_NO = PTL.ACCT_NO and STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT.ACCT_TYPE = PTL.ACCT_TYPE and CASH_ID is not null FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ) else PTL.CASH_ID end feeType
FROM STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT PTL INNER JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO STL ON PTL.ACCT_NO = STL.ACCT_NO left join fin_product on PTL.FINPROD_ID = fin_product.FINPROD_ID
left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD on FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID = PTL.FINPROD_ID WHERE 1=1
and PTL.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and PTL.FINPROD_ID in (select FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT where FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND p_finprod_id is null)

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID customerId, CUSTOMER_NAME customerName, CUSTOMER_TYPE customerType, nvl(IS_ISSUER,'') || ',' ||nvl(IS_FINANCIER,'') || ',' || nvl(IS_ASSTE_MANAGER,'') || ',' || nvl(IS_TRUSTER,'') || ',' ||nvl(IS_GUARANTEE,'') || ',' || nvl(IS_PLEDGOR,'') || ',' || nvl(IS_SALER,'') || ',' || nvl(IS_DEPOSIT_BANK,'') || ',' || nvl(IS_INVEST_ADVISER,'') customerCharater FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where 1=1
and (CUSTOMER_ID like concat(concat('%', #{search}), '%') or CUSTOMER_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{search}), '%'))

select * from (select t.*,f.investment_cycle, row_number() over() as rownum from fin_open_plan t left join FIN_PRODUCT pd on t.FINPROD_ID=pd.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD f on t.FINPROD_ID=f.FINPROD_ID where t.open_vdate >= to_date(#{PtDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and t.FINPROD_ID =#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by open_vdate) tp where tp.rownum = 1
